items.title: Dr. Jeff Gross’s Favorite Wearable
items.summary: ⌚ Dr. Jeff Gross’s Favorite Wearable: Why He Keeps Coming Back to Apple Watch Dr. Jeff Gross says he enjoys experimenting with different wearable devices, from smartwatches and rings to newer health-tracking technologies. Right now, he’s testing several options, including a new smart ring and a blood-pressure monitoring watch. He also wears an EMF-blocking device, although he openly acknowledges that he isn’t sure whether it actually works. But despite trying new technology, one device continues to stand out for him: the Apple Watch. 🍎⌚ One feature he particularly values is heart rate variability (HRV) tracking, which he considers an important metric for understanding aspects of his health and recovery. His approach highlights the rapidly evolving world of wearable technology: keep experimenting, learn what the data can tell you, and stay curious about new tools. 💡 The best wearable may not be the newest one—it may be the one that gives you useful information you can actually understand and use. #AppleWatch #WearableTechnology #HRV #HeartRateVariability #HealthTracking #FitnessTracking #Biohacking #HealthOptimization #Wellness #Recovery #Longevity #HealthTech

items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. My whole life doctors told me I'd need open heart surgery in my…

items.title: Not Every Biohack Is Worth Trying
items.summary: 🚫 Not Every Biohack Deserves a Try When Dr. Kevin White was asked about biohacks that seem crazy or need more research, he had a very clear example: drinking urine. He shared that he had heard of patients practicing urine drinking and questioned the reasoning behind it. His response was simple: just because something is labeled a “biohack” doesn’t mean it should automatically be considered a wellness strategy. The broader lesson is worth remembering in a world full of viral health trends: 🔬 Question the claim. 📚 Look for credible evidence. 🩺 Consider safety before experimenting. Not every unconventional practice deserves a place in your health routine. Sometimes, the smartest approach is knowing when to say no and move on. #Biohacking #HealthTrends #HealthEducation #Wellness #HealthyLiving #HealthOptimization #CriticalThinking #EvidenceBasedHealth #Longevity #BiohackingCommunity #WellnessJourney #HealthyHabits

items.title: Dr. Ken Sharlin’s Daily Supplements
items.summary: 💊 Dr. Ken Sharlin’s Daily Supplement Essentials When it comes to his daily supplement routine, Dr. Ken Sharlin, M.D., keeps his focus on a few key nutrients. His essentials include: ☀️ Vitamin D 🐟 Omega-3 fish oil — specifically a high-quality, potent natural triglyceride form 🧬 B vitamins — including activated folate and B12 Rather than taking an endless list of supplements, his routine centers around a few specific nutrients that he considers important for his personal health strategy. Of course, supplement needs can vary from person to person. Diet, lifestyle, lab results, medications, and individual health goals all matter when deciding what may be appropriate. 💡 The takeaway: A thoughtful supplement routine starts with knowing what your body actually needs. #Supplements #VitaminD #Omega3 #FishOil #B12 #Folate #BComplex #Nutrition #Wellness #HealthyLiving #HealthOptimization #Longevity

items.excerpt: 🎈FREE Masterclass: How To MICRODOSE GLP-1 HOLISTICALLY Release 20 lbs in 12 Weeks 👉 https://go.elizabethmcgann.com/masterclass (Without the Side Effects, Muscle Loss, or Being on Medication for Life) If you’ve been hearing about GLP-1 medications and wondering whether they might help you… But you also feel nervous, skeptical, or unsure… then this is the perfect episode for you. Here’s what most people aren’t learning about online: Weight loss struggles exist on a spectrum. For some women (especially after 40), improving nutrition, gut health, and blood sugar can completely change their health. Some might not need a GLP-1 at all… or may only need a microdose for additional support. But for others…the problem runs much deeper. Today’s guest, Rachael Gullette, is a GLP-1 advocate and content creator who has lost more than 160 POUNDS. She lived on the far end of the spectrum and has spent her life navigating severe obesity, PCOS, ADHD, binge eating disorder, and deep metabolic dysfunction. Her brain was wired for constant dopamine-seeking, and food became the coping mechanism. When she started a GLP-1 medication… everything changed. *In this episode, you’ll learn:* • what “food noise” actually feels like • why some women can lose weight naturally and others can’t • how GLP-1 impacts brain chemistry, metabolism, and behavior • and how to start understanding where you fall on the spectrum This episode is about helping you understand your body and choosing the level of support…
